patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 3 explicitly limits its model identity to prepared US7763818B2 and states that requested US10036408B2 is not represented because evidence for it is absent. The four-bar, pin-location-as-part prose, slider-crank links, union, base hinge, optional reflector, and motion conversion are supported by retrieved US7763818B2 claim/description passages. No facts for US10036408B2 are asserted.

functional_completeness.rationale: The revision retains the supported planar member, its rigid/compliant four-bar members and pin-location detail, the coupler/output link and collapsible union, base substrate, and supported in-plane to out-of-plane function. Removing the pin-location flow port is a sound structural clarification; it does not omit a flow-bearing interface. No unsupported actuator/control/feedback behavior is added.

flow_consistency.rationale: PLANAR_IN no longer asserts an unsupported physical flow type, and the pin locations are no longer modeled as a mechanical-motion flow. The remaining mechanical_motion flows describe internal mechanical linkage motion at the planar-output/coupler and output-link/base-hinge interfaces, consistent with the cited description. The external actuation type remains unspecified.

claim_traceability.rationale: Each modeled mechanism element/function has cited claim or description support, including the four-bar detail (claims 2-3), slider-crank and hinge elements (claims 6-9), reflector (claims 10-11), and illustrated motion sequence. No invented requirements or control claims are present. The patent identity boundary is candidly stated.

interfaces.rationale: The PLANAR_OUT-to-SPH_IN and SPH_BASE_HINGE-to-BASE_HINGE interfaces reference existing ports and flows with compatible mechanical-motion types and are recorded once. Removing the pin-location pseudo-port resolves the earlier semantic concern. Input has no asserted flow type or fabricated external mating component.

textbook_application.rationale: Textbook guidance supports distinguishing system boundary flows/interfaces and avoiding unsupported assumptions; it is used only as modeling-method guidance, not as evidence for invention facts. The candidate appropriately leaves actuation-source/type and optical routing unspecified. No structural error is present.

summary: Independent review of saved SJS revision 3 finds the prior input-flow-type issue resolved: PLANAR_IN has no unsupported flow_type. The pin-location flow port has been removed while its supported location detail remains in the rigid-member part description. The two modeled mechanical interfaces connect existing compatible ports and flows; four-bar members and linkage behavior remain grounded in retrieved US7763818B2 passages. Scope is explicit and accurate for available evidence: US7763818B2 is modeled, while requested US10036408B2 is not represented. No remaining actionable issue found; no candidate edits were made.
